description: This file defines classes related to warning reporting categories, specifically for handling plugin states and long invocation messages within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, enums, and static configuration methods.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin with analysis, serialization, and string conversion capabilities, including configuration options.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Encapsulates messages related to long invocation durations, supporting multiple message types and analysis methods.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes different types of messages or plugin states, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.description: Serializes the object to a byte array (not yet implemented).

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a byte array (not yet implemented).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the object to a human-readable string representation.

methods.name: Configure
